evidence.field: description, source, reuse rights, file history
evidence.text: The page identifies 比-seal.svg as a modern vector drawing of 比 in Shuowen seal-script style, links the design to item s05946 on Hanziyuan, and records an 8 August 2009 upload. Commons states reuse is public domain and notes courtesy/permission from the Richard Sears website. This is a redraw, not an excavated inscription or proof of the character’s origin.
evidence.title: File:比-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: oracle-script description, provenance, reuse rights, file history
evidence.text: The project’s related 比-oracle.svg page identifies its drawing as 比 in Shang oracle script style and attributes it to Hanziyuan image j19532; its file history dates the upload to 8 August 2009. The category identifies an oracle-匕 association, but that project metadata does not independently establish the graph’s depicted referent or settle the disputed analysis. Commons records public-domain release of the SVG representation.
evidence.title: File:比-oracle.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: Old Chinese and Middle Chinese rows
evidence.text: The local Baxter–Sagart 2014 table gives 比 bǐ, MC pjijX, OC *C.pijʔ (‘compare’); 比 bì, MC pjijH, OC *pij-s (‘combine; all’); and 匕 bǐ, MC pjijX, OC *pijʔ (‘ladle, spoon’; ‘spoon’). These are the local rows’ exact values; resemblance between 匕 and one reading of 比 is not by itself proof of component role.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (13 September 2014)

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 比-seal.svg; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: Shuowen Seal Radical 291.svg
search_audit.outcome: Search found and exposed the 比-seal.svg description. Direct open of the radical file page returned an internal error; a related search result pointed instead to the general 540-radical chart.

Commons search/open confirmed the seal redraw and the related oracle drawing’s project attribution, script label, upload date and public-domain notice. Unicode search did not surface the requested official records, and direct opens of the codepoint pages failed.

gaps: The workspace filesystem was read-only, so no downloaded pixels could be rendered or inspected during this task. The local SVG path data was readable, but a shape appearance should not be claimed from that alone.

The second candidate, Shuowen Seal Radical 291.svg, could not be tied to an individually inspected source page; a general chart surfaced, but it is not a character-specific historical witness. It is not selected.
The direct Wikimedia raw-file URLs were inaccessible to the web tool. Commons description pages were inspected instead.

Official Unicode Unihan pages for 比 and 匕 were attempted but unavailable through the browser. The exact local kMandarin and Baxter–Sagart rows were checked, but the official Unihan click-through verification remains outstanding.

The seal image is a sourced modern redraw in a stated Shuowen style; it can illustrate that labeled graphic form, but it does not establish Shang forms, historical dating, component identity, or disputed etymology.
